paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the standard deviation of logarithmic perplexity across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0 to 35 and tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Perplexity (log) Std" and is also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.00 to 1.75 and tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The plot features a single line in orange, with diamond-shaped markers and a solid line style. At the start of the x-axis, the line appears at approximately just above 1.75, and it exhibits a steep decline, reaching around 0.25 by layer 4. The line continues to decrease more gradually, leveling off to near 0.00 as it approaches layer 20, showing smaller fluctuations throughout the remaining layers.
